string.name: myday_error_offline
string.description: Shown instead of My Day when it could not be loaded because there is no connection.

resources.string: You\'re offline. Connect to the internet and try again.

string.name: myday_error_timeout
string.description: Shown instead of My Day when loading timed out.

resources.string: Your day took too long to load. Try again.

string.name: myday_error_generic
string.description: Shown instead of My Day when loading failed and the server gave no reason.

resources.string: We couldn\'t load your day. Try again.

string.name: myday_rollback_complete
string.description: Beside a task whose completion the server refused; the check was undone.

resources.string: Couldn\'t mark this done. It\'s back on your list.

string.name: myday_rollback_reopen
string.description: Beside a task whose reopening the server refused.

resources.string: Couldn\'t reopen this task. It\'s still done.

string.name: myday_rollback_check_in
string.description: Beside a habit whose check-in the server refused; the check was undone.

string.name: myday_rollback_undo_check_in
string.description: Beside a habit whose undo the server refused.

string.name: myday_rollback_reason
string.description: A refused change, then the server's reason. Both are full sentences.

string.name: myday_rollback_retry
string.description: Button beside a refused change that sends it again.

string.name: myday_empty_title
string.description: Title when today has no tasks, habits or calendar items.

string.name: myday_empty_title_other_day
string.description: Title when another date has no tasks, habits or calendar items.

string.name: myday_empty_message
string.description: Message under the empty My Day title.

resources.string: Add what\'s on your mind and Michael will help you fit it into the day.

string.name: myday_empty_action
string.description: Button on the empty My Day that opens Tasks.

string.name: myday_greeting
string.description: My Day's title: the server's greeting, such as Good evening, then the user's name.

string.name: myday_previous_day
string.description: Accessibility label of the button that shows the day before.

string.name: myday_next_day
string.description: Accessibility label of the button that shows the day after.

string.name: myday_today
string.description: Button that returns My Day to today.

string.name: myday_offline
string.description: Banner when a refresh failed for lack of connection; the time the shown data was loaded.

resources.string: You\'re offline. Showing your day as of %s.

string.name: myday_refresh_failed
string.description: Banner when a refresh failed for another reason; the time the shown data was loaded.

resources.string: Couldn\'t refresh. Showing your day as of %s. Pull down to try again.

string.name: myday_notices_title
string.description: Title of the card of observations computed from the user's saved data.

string.name: myday_progress_today
string.description: Label of the progress card on today.

string.name: myday_progress_other_day
string.description: Label of the progress card on another date.

plurals.name: myday_progress_done
plurals.description: Tasks completed out of the day's tasks; the quantity is the total.

plurals.name: myday_progress_unclassified
plurals.description: Tasks whose status on a past date is unknown.
plurals.item: %d with no saved status for this day
%d with no saved status for this day

string.name: myday_progress_next
string.description: The next calendar item today: its kind, such as Focus session, then its time range.

string.name: myday_section_retry
string.description: Button beside a section of My Day that could not be loaded.

string.name: myday_timeline_title
string.description: Heading of the day's calendar items.

string.name: myday_timeline_clear
string.description: Shown when the day has no calendar items.

string.name: myday_timeline_more
string.description: Button when the server sent only some of the day's calendar items.

resources.string: More on this day in Calendar

string.name: myday_timeline_failed
string.description: Shown when the day's calendar items failed to load.

string.name: myday_timeline_label_with_status
string.description: A calendar item's kind, then the status of its task on that day.

string.name: myday_tasks_title
string.description: Heading of the day's tasks.

string.name: myday_tasks_failed
string.description: Shown when the day's tasks failed to load.

string.name: myday_tasks_none
string.description: Shown when the day has no tasks but has other items.

string.name: myday_task_reopen
string.description: Accessibility label of a done task's check.

string.description: Accessibility label of an open task's check.

string.description: Chip on a task whose status on a past date is not recorded.

string.description: Chip on a task past its due date.

string.name: myday_status_in_progress
string.description: A task's status.

string.name: myday_status_done
string.description: A task's status.

string.name: myday_status_pending
string.description: A task's status.

string.name: myday_habits_title
string.description: Heading of today's habits.

string.name: myday_habits_failed
string.description: Shown when today's habits failed to load.

string.name: myday_habits_none
string.description: Shown when no habit is scheduled today but the day has other items.

string.name: myday_habits_read_only
string.description: Shown above habits on a date other than today.

string.name: myday_habit_streak
string.description: A habit's current streak in days.

string.name: myday_habit_undo
string.description: Accessibility label of a checked-in habit's check.

string.description: Accessibility label of a habit's check.
